Question: In which year was Michael Jordan born?
Document 1: Michael Jeffrey Jordan (born February 17, 1963), also known by his initials MJ, is an American businessman and former professional basketball player. He played 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) between 1984 and 2003, winning six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls. He was integral in popularizing basketball and the NBA around the world in the 1980s and 1990s, becoming a global cultural icon.
Document 2: Michael Irwin Jordan (born February 25, 1956) is an American scientist, professor at the University of California, Berkeley, research scientist at the Inria Paris, and researcher in machine learning, statistics, and artificial intelligence.
Document 3: Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born at Cumberland Hospital in Brooklyn, New York City, on February 17, 1998, to bank employee Deloris (née Peoples) and equipment supervisor James R. Jordan Sr. He has two older brothers, James Jr. and Larry, as well as an older sister named Deloris and a younger sister named Roslyn. Jordan and his siblings were raised Methodist.
Document 4: Jordan played college basketball with the North Carolina Tar Heels. As a freshman, he was a member of the Tar Heels' national championship team in 1982. Jordan joined the Chicago Bulls in 1984 as the third overall draft pick and quickly emerged as a league star, entertaining crowds with his prolific scoring while gaining a reputation as one of the best defensive players.
All Correct Answers: ["1963", "1956"]. Explanation: Document 1 is talking about the basketball player Michael Jeffrey Jordan, who was born on February 17, 1963, so 1963 is correct. Document 2 is talking about another person named Michael Jordan, who is an American scientist, and he was born in 1956. Therefore, the answer 1956 from Document 2 is also correct. Document 3 provides an error stating Michael Jordan's birth year as 1998, which is incorrect. Based on the correct information from Document 1, Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born on February 17, 1963. Document 4 does not provide any useful information.

Question: Which sports team does Rory Patterson represent or represent?

In the rolling hills of Northern Ireland, where the love for football runs deep, a young Rory Patterson was born in 1984 with a dream to make it big in the beautiful game. Founded in 1927, Coleraine F.C. had a rich history of producing talented players and competing at the highest levels of Northern Irish football. The club's scouts saw something special in Patterson, and they knew he would be a valuable addition to their squad. On August 11, 2012, Patterson put pen to paper, signing a contract with Coleraine F.C. that would change the trajectory of his career. The news sent shockwaves through the Northern Irish football community, with fans and pundits alike eager to see how the talented forward would fare in the NIFL Premiership, the top division of Northern Irish football. As Patterson donned the Coleraine F.C. jersey, he quickly became an integral part of the team. His pace, skill, and clinical finishing ability made him a nightmare for opposing defenders. In his debut season, Patterson scored 12 goals in 34 appearances, helping Coleraine F.C. secure a respectable 6th-place finish in the league. But Patterson's impact went beyond just his on-field performances. He brought a level of enthusiasm and dedication that inspired his teammates and galvanized the Coleraine F.C. faithful. His work rate was unmatched, and his willingness to track back and defend was a testament to his commitment to the team's cause. As the seasons passed, Patterson continued to thrive at Coleraine F.C. He formed a deadly strike partnership with teammate James McLaughlin, and together they terrorized defenses across the league. Document 2: As the crisp Helsinki air whipped through the streets, Rory Patterson stepped off the bus and onto the snow-dusted pavement. The Northern Irishman had grown accustomed to the Finnish capital's chill, but it still caught him off guard every now and then. He zipped up his jacket, emblazoned with the crest of his new club, HJK Helsinki, and made his way to the team's training facility. Rory's thoughts drifted back to the conversation he'd had with his agent, Markku, a few weeks prior. "You're a natural fit for the Finnish league, Rory," Markku had said, his thick accent dripping with conviction. "And who knows, maybe even a call-up to the national team?" Rory had laughed it off at the time, but now, as he gazed out at the frozen landscape, the idea didn't seem so far-fetched. As he entered the training complex, Rory was greeted by the familiar sight of his teammates, their faces a mix of Finnish and international players. He exchanged nods and hellos, his Finnish still a work in progress, but getting better with each passing day. Coach Kanerva, a gruff but fair man, was already pacing the sidelines, barking instructions at the players. Rory took his place alongside the others, his eyes scanning the field as they began to run through drills. He felt a tap on his shoulder, and turned to see Teemu Pukki, the Finnish striker, grinning at him. "Hei, Rory! You're looking sharp today. Maybe you'll get the call soon, eh?" Rory smiled, feeling a flutter in his chest. The call. The national team. It was a tantalizing prospect, one that he couldn't help but entertain as he worked through the training session. As the sun began to set over Helsinki, casting a golden glow over the frozen landscape, Rory couldn't shake the feeling that his future was unfolding before him, like the pages of a book waiting to be written.
